# Shared cases: what plays when a track reaches its end.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/track_end_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/services/track_end_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <repeat mode>  <has next>  <action>
#
# repeat mode: off | all | one
# action:      replay | next | restart | stop

off	true	next
off	false	stop
all	true	next
all	false	restart
one	true	replay
one	false	replay
